Hey, Everyone! Did You Miss Me!? After a 2-month absence, Moral Succubus is back to bring you your favourite soft-core corruption series: Symbiotic Companion! This is the 2nd half of episode 7 that I did last year, which I had to cut short because I wanted to work on the finale for Latex Rangers. Well, it is done now, so I am here to present you with what you want! I hope you all enjoy it!

Where we last left off, Genny discovers that her college professor has secretly been a government agent, and he is forced to bring her in. While Genny was adamant about handing herself in, Symbie convinces her that it would be the safer option and that he doesn't want to see her hurt. Meanwhile, Jane has already fallen under Nadia's influence, while Sophie was patrolling the night, and she spotted a woman in trouble with a symbiote spawn. How will Sophie save the night? What will happen to Genny and Jane? And how will Genny respond when she finds out the awful truth? Find out here in Symbiotic Companion Episode 7- The Darkest Before The Dawn (Part 2)!
